transcription: Transcribed by Claude from the original screenshots on 2026-10-14; must be independently checked by a human before it counts as golden data.

source.provided: original files from the game's screenshot folder (file names kept in conditions.originalFile)
source.redaction: Lossless block wipe with jpegtran -wipe (libjpeg-turbo 2.1.5) over the CURRENT BALANCE value and over the Session line of the r_DisplayInfo overlay; every pixel outside the two rectangles is identical to the original.

localisation.note: The game's language file in use when the captures were taken. It is game content and is not committed; it lives in the private corpus next to the originals.

observations: The r_DisplayInfo debug overlay is on in every capture; its lower lines run across the shop panel's header and tab row, but no card.

All 15 buy and 68 sell commodities that UEX lists for this terminal appear in the captures, and every transcribed price equals UEX's latest value. UEX's values were updated within minutes of the captures, so they may already contain them (post-capture prior).

Pitambu is never complete: it is cut at the bottom of sell-16 and at the top of sell-17, although every field is legible in both, so it produces no row; with overlapping captures only a UEX assortment entry names it in the gap check (O-132).
Hydrogen Fuel (sell-19) shows 'Out of Stock' with 4 SCU, against the screen rule 'Out of Stock => 0 SCU' (O-131).
Silicon on the buy side is dimmed: 2 SCU are available and the smallest container size is 8 (the hypothesis of pyro-gateway-stanton-01).
The sell side has a collapsed SELLABLE CARGO header above IN DEMAND and a collapsed NO DEMAND header after the last card inside the shop panel (A21).
Most IN DEMAND cards show 'Out of Stock' with 0 SCU; Methane (1,142 SCU, Medium Inventory) and Hydrogen Fuel (4 SCU, Out of Stock) show stock.
Prices span 1 to 4,600,000 UEC per SCU (HexaPolyMesh Coating, Luminalia Gift); seven-digit prices with two thousands separators occur.
Pressurized Ice, Savrilium, Lindinium, Torite and Aslarite are drawn without a commodity icon.
Revenant Tree Pollen and the Ship Ammunition sizes wrap to two lines on the buy side; Ship Ammunition without a size is a separate sell commodity at 9 UEC.
The order of the IN DEMAND cards is not alphabetical by displayed name.
Recycled Material Composite: the right-aligned '0 SCU' overlaps the end of the name (F6).
